purpose: claims 0,1 with verifier source and computed equalities (new evidence after d012 review)

claims: In all 548 FR2 .ptg files the header satisfies count == columns*rows, stride == cell, columns == ceil(width/cell) and rows == ceil(height/cell), with zero violations.
The 17 .ptg files whose last header word is 0xDDDDDDDD all have sizes exactly equal to 1120 + 1104 times their tile count.
